overview: This file consists of a single Department of State list-of-papers sheet indexing two reports concerning political and ceremonial affairs in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records a September 12, 1935 report prepared by former Dairen consul John Carter Vincent and transmitted from the U.S. Legation at Nanking by Atcheson, and an October 6, 1936 report from Dairen by Grummon describing the postponed celebration of the Kwantung Government’s thirtieth anniversary, including excerpts from speeches. The sheet also supplies a cross-reference to decimal-file item 894C.01/84.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: An archival index sheet identifies reports from Nanking and Dairen concerning the Kwantung Leased Territory and the Kwantung Government’s thirtieth-anniversary celebration.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists a report dated September 12, 1935, prepared by former Dairen consul John Carter Vincent and transmitted from the U.S. Legation at Nanking in association with Atcheson. It also lists an October 6, 1936 report from Dairen associated with Grummon, describing the celebration held on October 1 after postponement from the actual September 1 anniversary. The latter report reportedly provides particulars and excerpts from speeches, and the sheet refers researchers to file 894C.01/84.

interest: Although the underlying reports are not present here, this index sheet is useful for reconstructing their provenance, dates, authorship, and archival relationships. It identifies John Carter Vincent as the author of a report on the leased territory and points to a potentially rich account of the Kwantung Government’s anniversary rituals and official speeches. The note that the celebration was postponed from the true anniversary date may also help historians distinguish administrative chronology from commemorative staging.
